strategies.name: Detection of Activate Firmware Update Mode

analytics.name: Analytic 1934
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol message sequence placing a field device into firmware-update mode from a source not in the approved engineering workstation list, correlated with the device's alarm telemetry going silent within a short grace period without acknowledgment. Documented precedent: Industroyer exploited CVE-2015-5374 by sending a crafted packet that initiated an incomplete firmware update sequence on Siemens Protection Technology (SIPROTEC) relays. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
